visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A metal scoop pours translucent white pearls into a light pink drink filled with ice. The cup features a circular black logo with white text. Transition to an indoor shop where two customers, a male in a pink shirt and a female in grey, stand at a service counter. (2) A hand wearing a purple nitrile glove pours thick red strawberry jam from a silver jigger into a clear cup. White milk is poured in, followed by golden-brown tea from a pitcher. A long metal spoon stirs the liquid, creating vibrant pink and white marble textures among the ice cubes. (3) Light brown tea is poured into a pitcher containing white milk. A steam wand is immersed in the liquid, creating frothy bubbles. The resulting hot pink beverage is poured into a paper cup decorated with a row of red strawberry illustrations and a logo. (4) Golden honey flows from a squeeze bottle into a silver jigger. It is added to a cup of milk and tea. The camera zooms in as the liquids blend, forming creamy brown swirls. The final drink has a thick layer of white foam on top, shown in a bright outdoor setting. (5) Golden tea is poured into a paper cup. A hand holds up a white plastic bag containing three drinks. A digital menu displays categories like 'Super Tea' and 'Au Lait' with prices. The video ends showing the black storefront sign of 'Supertea' under bright natural daylight.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Male narrator speaks with a high-pitched, energetic tone. Mid-tempo electronic BGM starts with a steady percussion beat and synth pads. Sound of liquid pouring and ice clinking against plastic is clearly audible. The narration is clear and well-enunciated. (2) Narrator continues describing ingredients like strawberry jam. A sharp digital 'ping' SFX emphasizes visual transitions. The sound of liquid splashing and pouring increases in volume. The BGM maintains a consistent rhythm and volume, supporting the upbeat mood of the vocal delivery. (3) A distinct, high-frequency hissing sound of a steam wand interrupts the flow, marking the preparation of a hot drink. The narrator's pitch remains high and friendly. The BGM continues without pause, blending with the rhythmic steaming sounds and the pour of the liquid into a cup. (4) The sound of thick honey flowing is heard as the narrator introduces 'Honey Au Lait'. The BGM's bass kick is prominent. Noises of stirring and cup movement provide a realistic acoustic environment for a cafe setting. The narrator's speech rate is moderate and consistent. (5) A plastic rustling sound occurs as a bag is lifted. The narrator gives a concluding remark and the shop's name. A final digital UI sound effect plays. The BGM slowly fades out as the shop's location is mentioned. Overall recording is studio-clean and clear.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for a specific tea shop, 'SUPERTEA (十口茶)', highlighting its seasonal strawberry drinks, preparation process (including hot and cold options), and unique artist-collaborated cup designs to attract customers to their Kaohsiung branch.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand logo, shop address, and specific menu items with descriptive positive narration.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and close-up 'food porn' style shots of liquid textures to create sensory appeal. The integration of the preparation process with the final product shot aims to emphasize freshness and quality.
